plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Lazy senior dev mode. Forces the simplest, shortest solution that actually works: YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions.

plugins.name: cowork-plugin-management
plugins.description: Create, customize, and manage plugins tailored to your organization's tools and workflows. Requires the Cowork desktop app environment — not plain Claude Code.

plugins.name: product-management
plugins.description: Write feature specs, plan roadmaps, and synthesize user research faster. Keep stakeholders updated and stay ahead of the competitive landscape. Can connect to Slack, Linear, Asana, Notion, Figma, Gmail, Calendar and more — each connection is opt-in per user, nothing connects automatically on install.

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: Manage tasks, plan your day, and build up memory of important context about your work. Syncs with your calendar, email, and chat to keep everything organized. Can connect to Slack, Notion, Asana, Linear and more — each connection is opt-in per user, nothing connects automatically on install.
